name: e-invoicing-tr-despatch-advice-type-codes
title: UBL-TR despatch advice type codes (e-İrsaliye)
description: DespatchAdviceTypeCode values accepted by the UBL-TR schematron for e-İrsaliye (SEVK, MATBUDAN). Kod Listeleri V1.43 has no named table for these codes; names are left empty. SEVK is also the only ReceiptAdviceTypeCode.

sources.title: e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (DespatchAdviceTypeCodeList, ReceiptAdviceTypeCodeList) and UBL-TR_Common_Schematron.xml DespatchAdviceTypeCode rules; package history up to 2026-07-01, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16

fields.name: name
fields.description: Official description. Empty: Kod Listeleri V1.43 does not define names for these codes.

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when DespatchAdviceTypeCodeList accepts the code.

fields.name: also_receipt_advice
fields.description: true when ReceiptAdviceTypeCodeList also accepts the code (SEVK only).
